description: This Java source file defines the PurgeableBitmap activity class, which demonstrates the effects of setting Bitmaps as purgeable in Android. It manages multiple components including a custom view, handler, and dialog interactions, to showcase how purgeable bitmaps influence memory management and decoding behavior.

classes.description: Main activity demonstrating purgeable bitmap effects in Android.
